AddressEmptyCode(address).details: There's no code at `target` (it is not a contract).

AddressInsufficientBalance(address).details: The ETH balance of the account is not enough to perform the operation.

AlreadyReferred(address,address).details: Error thrown when a user tries to refer but has already been referred by someone else.

AlreadySetError().details: Error thrown when a trying to set a variable to the value it already has.

CyclicReferenceError(address,address).details: Error thrown when a cyclic reference is detected in the referral chain.

FailedInnerCall().details: A call to an address target failed. The target may have reverted.

IncorrectOracle().details: Error thrown when the provided token does not match the Oracle's tokens.

IncorrectOraclePairTokens().details: Thrown when the tokens paired by the PAXE Oracle and the SUSD Oracle do not match.

IncorrectPaxeOracle().details: Error thrown when the provided PAXE token does not match the PAXE Oracle's tokens.

InsufficientBalance().details: Error thrown when the staked amount is less than the withdraw amount.

InsufficientPaxeTokens().details: Error thrown when the provided PAXE tokens are not enough for staking.

InsufficientRestakeAmount().details: Error thrown when the restaked amount is zero.

InsufficientRewards().details: Error thrown when there are not enough rewards in the contract.

InsufficientStakeAmount().details: Error thrown when the staked amount is less than the required minimum value.

InvalidEtherValue(uint256).details: Error thrown when the ether sent with the transaction is not equal to `value` ether.

InvalidNonceError(address,uint256).details: Error thrown when an invalid nonce is provided.

InvalidReferrerError(address,address).details: Error thrown when the referrer address provided is invalid.

InvalidSignatureError().details: Error thrown when the provided signature is invalid.

NoActiveStake().details: Error thrown when there is no active stake for the `msg.sender`.

OnlySigner().details: Error thrown when the msg.sender is not the signer wallet.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC20 token failed.

SelfReferError(address,address).details: Error thrown when a user tries to refer themselves.

SpecialReferrerStakeRewardOutOfBounds().details: Error thrown when the provided special referrer stake reward is out of bounds.

TokenAlreadyInPool().details: Error thrown when the provided token already exists in another pool.

TokenIsRewardToken().details: Error thrown when the provided token is the reward token and cannot be used.

ZeroAddressNotAllowed().details: Error thrown when the provided address is equal to the zero address.

constructor.details: Constructor for initializing the staking contract.

deposit(uint256,uint256,string).details: Stake an equal value of SUSD and PAXE tokens, use refCode.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setBurnDepositedPAXE(bool).details: Sets whether the deposited PAXE gets burned or remain in the liquid farming pool Callable only by the owner. Emits a {SetBurnDepositedPAXE} event.

setSignatureSigner(address).details: Sets the signer wallet. Callable only by the owner. Emits a {SignatureSignerUpdated} event.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.
